method: Labels selected from processed source text before running this benchmark; relevance means the document directly addresses the requested procedure or diagnosis. Empty sets require abstention. Cross-institution documents are evaluated for topical retrieval, not authority at CERTAN.

queries.query: WiFi kampus tersambung tetapi internet tidak dapat diakses. Bagaimana memeriksa koneksi nirkabel dan access point?
queries.evidence: DOC01: Step 1 isolates affected clients, SSID and access point; wireless connection troubleshooting.

queries.query: Laptop sering terputus dari jaringan nirkabel di satu SSID. Apa yang perlu dicek pada klien dan AP?
queries.evidence: DOC01: Step 1 distinguishes failed establishment from connection drops and asks about common SSID/AP.

queries.query: Nama domain gagal di-resolve. Bagaimana memeriksa DNS server dan konfigurasi klien?
queries.evidence: DOC02: DNS troubleshooting checklist covers server and client-side name resolution.

queries.query: Komputer klien tidak mendapatkan alamat IP dari DHCP server. Apa langkah troubleshooting?
queries.evidence: DOC03: DHCP server and client troubleshooting; DOC04: problems on the DHCP client and data collection.

queries.query: VLAN 9 pada Open vSwitch tidak terisolasi. Bagaimana memeriksa port trunk dan aturan OpenFlow?
queries.evidence: DOC06: Open vSwitch VLAN FAQ covers VLAN 9, trunk ports, and OpenFlow normal action.

queries.query: Paket sering hilang di jalur jaringan; bagaimana memakai pktmon dan statistik NIC untuk mencari titik drop?
queries.evidence: DOC07: capture packet loss with Pktmon and inspect NIC discard counters.

queries.query: Login 802.1X ditolak oleh NPS. Di mana melihat event 6273 dan masalah sertifikat EAP?
queries.evidence: DOC08: NPS event 6273 and EAP certificate troubleshooting; DOC01: 802.1X authentication failure checklist and certificates.

queries.query: Insiden jaringan prioritas P1 perlu eskalasi dan komunikasi kepada pengguna. Bagaimana prosedurnya?
queries.evidence: DOC09: service desk priority, escalation and user communication; DOC10: P1 incident escalation and communication. Both DRAFT.

queries.query: Gangguan layanan perlu dicatat, diprioritaskan, lalu ditutup. Apa alur tiket insiden?
queries.evidence: DOC09: ticket triage and closure; DOC10: incident logging, prioritization and closure; DOC11: UCF IT incident ticket lifecycle.

queries.query: Jika diduga ada insiden keamanan TI, siapa yang menerima laporan dan mengoordinasikan respons?
queries.evidence: DOC12: report suspected security incident to help desk; CISO/ISO and IRT direct response.

queries.query: Siapa yang boleh memasang access point WiFi pada jaringan universitas dan apakah AP pribadi diizinkan?
queries.evidence: DOC13 section 5.3: Wi-Fi infrastructure requires UIT approval and unauthorized access points are prohibited.

queries.query: Apa aturan penggunaan jaringan universitas dan perilaku pengguna yang dilarang?
queries.evidence: DOC14: Network Acceptable Use Policy defines acceptable and prohibited network use.

queries.query: Berapa harga nasi goreng dan jam buka kantin kampus besok?
queries.evidence: No processed corpus document contains cafeteria menus, food prices, or opening hours.

queries.query: Bagaimana prakiraan hujan dan suhu udara kota Bandung akhir pekan ini?
queries.evidence: No processed corpus document provides weather forecasts.
